Brazil’s B3 and Six Financial Institutions to Launch Real-Pegged Stablecoin in Q1 2027 According to Valor Econômico, Brazilian stock exchange B3 has partnered with Bradesco, BTG Pactual, Itaú Unibanco, Safra, Santander and XP to launch Open BRL in Q1 2027. Issued by Banco B3 and backed 1:1 by Brazilian reais, the stablecoin will facilitate cross-institution transfers and tokenized stock settlement. The partners will jointly fund the project, with investment amounts undisclosed. Other financial institutions can join from launch. — link

WuBlockchain Weekly: UK Tightens DeFi Oversight, US Bitcoin Reserve Bill Advances, ECB Approves Tokenized Securities as Collateral The UK plans to restrict retail DeFi trading via regulated exchanges. The US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill advanced to the House calendar. The ECB approved tokenized securities as collateral. CFTC prediction market rules advanced to White House review, while the US DOJ seeks to seize over $1B in crypto stolen in the Binance hack. OKXICE faced objections from 56 listed companies. For the full weekly roundup, subscribe to our Substack: — link

Binance Partners With UK Internet Watch Foundation to Track Crypto Payments Linked to Child Sexual Abuse Material Bloomberg reported that Binance has partnered with the UK’s Internet Watch Foundation (IWF) to combat crypto payments linked to child sexual abuse material. Over three weeks in November, Binance received 27 alerts from the IWF and identified around 1,000 users directly or indirectly linked to flagged wallet addresses. Binance is the first crypto exchange to receive the IWF’s enhanced alerts and will suspend accounts making such payments, block further transactions and report suspicious activity to relevant authorities. — link

KuCoin to Delist Privacy Coin Monero (XMR) on November 30, Following Binance and OKX KuCoin announced it will delist all Monero (XMR) spot trading pairs on November 30. XMR deposits have been permanently disabled, while withdrawals are scheduled to close on December 31. KuCoin will also discontinue XMR savings, conversion and spot trading bot services. Binance and OKX previously delisted XMR in 2024, while Kraken has discontinued XMR trading for users in several jurisdictions, including the EEA, Canada and India. — link
